description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Dress Down removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
